name: Demoscene Twister
promptTemplate: A demoscene twister with {{slice_count}} slices, {{twist_turns}} full turns, {{column_width}} radius, in {{palette_mode}} palette with {{shading_style}} shading and {{flare_intensity}} glow flare.

slice_count.hint: Raster scanline density from retro bars to silk

twist_turns.hint: Crank to wind the column into tight coils

flare_intensity.hint: Atmospheric beam glow behind the column

gallery.blurb: A twister: a tall column that twists around its vertical axis, drawn as horizontal slices where each slice shows the faces visible between four sine-driven edges, each face shaded by how far it turns towards the light, twisting faster on the beat.
gallery.prompt: A twister: a tall column that twists around its vertical axis, drawn as horizontal slices where each slice shows the faces visible between four sine-driven edges, each face shaded by how far it turns towards the light, twisting faster on the beat. Build it with a demoscener's economy: one core technique done well, lookup tables and fixed-size buffers kept in room.state, nothing allocated inside hot loops, a steady 60fps at 1920x1080, and compact, clearly named code.
